thesis: Cultural practices organize encounters and criteria without making cultures uniform or mutually unintelligible.

ideas.statement: Biological capacity and learned practices interact; variation in taste challenges simplistic universality without proving biology irrelevant.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: The Tsimane sound comparison challenges universal consonance preference, not all biological contributions; coherent rituals can sustain relationships or demand simulated feeling.
